pages.title: Two Kinds of Bad Weather
pages.text: Successfully produce one concrete elemental outcome: Fireball explosion, Ray of Frost freeze or Chain Lightning connections.

pages.title: Two Kinds of Bad Weather
pages.text: Distinguish explosion, freeze and chaining as three elemental outcomes.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Fireball needs an actual impact/explosion; the frost ray can hit a block, but freezing needs an entity. Chain Lightning needs a valid initial target and its own chain. Pressing cast proves none of these results.
